name: Nechryael

unlocks.name: Nechs Please
unlocks.notes: Number of nechryael assigned is increased to 200-250.

variantInfo.name: Nechryael
notes: Regular Nechryael are found in the Slayer Tower and Charred Dungeon.
Normal Nechryael have lower Slayer experience rates, but their seed drops are useful for Ironman Herblore and their malicious ashes can be offered more frequently.

variantInfo.name: Greater Nechryael
notes: A stronger variant of Nechryael, with a slightly different drop table.
Greater Nechryael are highly recommended whenever possible because their drop table is more lucrative.

variantInfo.name: Nechryarch
notes: Superior variant of the Nechryael. Summons Chaotic death spawns.
Both regular and Greater Nechryael share the Nechryarch superior, with its common drop table based on the variant that spawned it.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower (basement)
notes: Can only be killed on a slayer task.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Contains 14 Greater Nechryael in two chambers of seven each.
Easily accessible with a portal attuned to Great Kourend or with Xeric's talisman.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Can only be killed on a slayer task.
Dangerous multicombat area, popular with player-killers. Do not bring items that you are unwilling to lose.

locationComparison.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Quickly accessed with a teleport crystal.
Requires completion of Song of the Elves.
Greater Nechryael killed here can drop crystal shards.

locationComparison.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Contains regular Nechryael split into two low-density groups, so it is discouraged for barraging.

taskNotes: Nechryael are a type of demon assigned at 80 Slayer and 85 combat.
They are an extremely good Slayer task because of frequent herbs, seeds, and alchable drops.
Nechryael attack with melee and periodically summon up to two death spawns.
death spawn attacks have a max hit of 2, use typeless melee, and Protect from Melee has no effect on them.
Death spawns can attack in single-combat areas even when the player is already in combat.
Bring food when using Melee or runes for blood spells when using Magic to manage death spawn chip damage.
Greater Nechryael are mechanically the same as regular Nechryael but have higher stats and a more lucrative drop table.
Both regular and Greater Nechryael share Nechryarch as their superior, although the common drop table follows whichever variant spawned it.
Nechryarch can summon a trio of chaotic death spawn, one each using melee, magic, and ranged.
Chaotic death spawn attacks hit much harder than normal death spawns, but can be blocked with prayer.
Nechryarch chaotic death spawns only appear if the Nechryarch can attack the player, so safespots or farcasting prevent the summon.
Fast tasks are encouraged in the Catacombs with fourteen Greater Nechryael split into two chambers of seven each.
A goading potion is ideal in the Catacombs because Nechryael are not aggressive and luring is needed for high experience rates.
If not using Magic on Greater Nechryael, the task page recommends melee in Iorwerth Dungeon because Catacombs melee is likely to be crashed and Iorwerth drops crystal shards.
For Krystilia assignments, use the Wilderness Slayer Cave, bring a goading potion and a one-click teleport, and treat it as a popular player killing hotspot.
Normal Nechryael give lower Slayer experience rates, but Ironman players may value their seed drops and faster malicious ashes for Prayer experience.
Charred Dungeon requires 60 Sailing, is far from most locations without a docked boat and greater teleport focus, and is discouraged because the spawns are split into small groups.
recommendedMethod: Burst or barrage Greater Nechryael in the Catacombs with goading potion support for fast tasks; use Emberlight or Arclight for melee Nechryael, Iorwerth Dungeon for non-magic Greater Nechryael, and Wilderness precautions for Krystilia tasks.
